[Sir](/person/2382)
My only [paper](/book/268) in [Atalanta](/periodical/53) is on the Life of [Mr Keble](/person/798). Those on Novel writing are by Mr [Walter Besant](/person/1652)[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^2]: This was an autograph hunter\'s trick to get a signature, see Martin Ray, \'Thomas Hardy\'s Letter to Charles Hiatt\' Notes and Queries 53 (2006), 338.
